statuses.name: Ready
statuses.description: spec written and sized: run /factory <issue#> to build it

statuses.name: Needs human
statuses.description: escalated: run /factory approve, revise or reject <issue or PR>

statuses.name: Done
statuses.description: merged, or closed unmerged when labeled rejected

labels.name: needs-triage
labels.description: Waiting for a maintainer to run /factory triage

labels.name: needs-info
labels.description: Triage asked the filer a question

labels.name: external
labels.description: Filed from outside the core team; a human approves the merge

labels.name: factory:stop
labels.description: Halt this run before its next stage move; set by /factory stop

labels.name: next
labels.description: Groomed to build next; set by /factory groom

labels.name: needs-split
labels.description: Estimated over settings.size_limit; split it at /factory groom

labels.name: blocker
labels.description: Review finding severity: must be fixed before the PR merges

labels.name: nit
labels.description: Review finding severity: minor, can wait

labels.name: code
labels.description: Review finding type: found by reviewer-code

labels.name: security
labels.description: Review finding type: found by reviewer-security

labels.name: ops
labels.description: Review finding type: found by reviewer-ops

labels.name: ux
labels.description: Review finding type: found by reviewer-ux

labels.name: ui-design
labels.description: Review finding type: found by reviewer-ui-design

reviewers.name: reviewer-code
reviewers.reason: correctness, tests and conventions, including Swift, Objective-C and the Xcode project and packages

reviewers.name: reviewer-ops
reviewers.reason: scripts, skills, agents, workflows, the loop, or the Xcode project, scheme and Swift packages

reviewers.name: reviewer-ux
reviewers.reason: docs, issue templates or app UI (SwiftUI views in VIRT/, asset catalogs, images)

reviewers.name: reviewer-ui-design
reviewers.reason: visual files or app UI (SwiftUI views in VIRT/, asset catalogs, images)
